sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: pleasant natural sweetener identity. People value it as a recognisable sweetener rather than as structural nutrition. Easy to use in drinks and foods. Simple practical upside. Familiar and common. That keeps it relevant to score at all.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Cons next: sweet format can stack up fast. Small-looking portions can still push a meal away from the cleaner use case. Heat processing weakens the case further. Processed honey loses some of the argument raw honey might have made. Overall payoff is weak for misc. The upside does not outweigh the sugar concentration strongly enough.
